products.$comment: A product sold in colours: list each colour by its id from CatalogEdit, with its photo and the colour of its circle (a six-digit code like #c9a54a). The product's own id comes first; it groups the colours into one card.

categoryPageStyle.$comment: CATEGORY PAGE STYLE. Every setting here says "default", which means it follows the same setting in Home.json > "categoryPages", so every category page looks the same. To give only this category its own look, replace "default" with a value (a colour such as #3f4d46, an opacity from 0 to 1, a font name, a size such as 1.5rem, or your own words); everything left as "default" keeps following Home.json. Put "default" back to undo it. Only the words above it (slug, label, title, description, image) and the products list differ per category.

basePalette.$comment: BASE COLOURS for this category page only. Anything without its own colour below uses these.

hero.$comment: TOP OF THE CATEGORY PAGE: the All collections button, then the category title and description (their words are edited at the top of this file).

allCollectionsButton.$comment: ALL COLLECTIONS BUTTON (same look as the cart's Continue shopping button). normal = resting, hover = mouse over.

subcategories.$comment: SUBCATEGORIES (only on categories whose card file in SiteEdit/Categories has a subcategories list). Each subcategory gets a heading with its products under it. When there are two or more, a row of jump buttons sits above the first heading; each one goes to its subcategory and is also a link you can share, such as /category/hair-care#hair-coloring. otherHeadingText = the heading over products that have no subcategory. unavailableHeadingText = the heading of the last group, under More, holding products that are Temporarily Unavailable (it has no jump button). headingLine = the thin line under each heading. jumpButtons: normal = resting, hover = mouse over.

backToTopButton.$comment: BACK TO TOP BUTTON under the cards (see Home.json > categoryPages > backToTopButton).

productCards.$comment: THE PRODUCT CARDS. Product names and prices come from the shop database, so only their look is set here.

colorSwatches.$comment: COLOUR CIRCLES (only on products sold in colours). They sit right under the price, centred, and wrap onto a second row if there are many. Each colour's circle colour (swatch) and photo are set in this file's products list, under that colour's id. circleSize and gap: a size such as 1.6rem or 26px. The ring marks the chosen colour; a faded circle with a line through it is sold out in every size (it can still be tapped to see its photo).

shades.$comment: SHADES (only on products where a colour has shades). Each shade's circle colour (swatch) and photo are set in this file's products list, inside its colour, under the shade's id. noteText = the words above the circles. A colour with shades has a small arrow mark on its circle; tapping it opens a menu of its shades, and once a shade is picked the circle takes the shade's colour. chooseShadeText = the Add to cart button's wording until a shade is picked. The menu uses the size dropdown's menu colours below.

sizeButtons.$comment: SIZE BUTTONS (for products with a few sizes such as S, M, L). 'highlight' is the look when hovered or selected. 'soldOut' is the look of a size with none left: it can't be tapped, and its words get a line through them (soldOutLineColor). soldOutFade fades the whole button, gold bar included: 1 = no fade, 0.4 = quite faint.

sizeDropdown.$comment: SIZE DROPDOWN (for products with a longer list of sizes, such as shoes). The same look is used for the cart's State, Town and Pickup menus. 'optionSoldOut' is the look of a size with none left in the menu: it can't be picked, and its words get a line through them. optionSoldOutFade fades the whole option: 1 = no fade, 0.4 = quite faint. Sold-out shades in the shade menu use the same look.

addButton.$comment: ADD TO CART BUTTON. text = normal wording, addedText = wording for a moment after adding, chooseSizeText = wording while a size is still needed. States: normal, hover (mouse over), pressed (just clicked), disabled (size not chosen yet).
